name: BRAMS grounded assistant evaluation v2
note: 54 product tasks; final factual/grounding verdicts require human review. Reference notes are examples, not substitutes for captured evidence. Each case has a fresh chat, with actual setup turns for C/F follow-ups.

cases.reference_notes: Latest 2026-11-01 reference: 74 receivers, 65 sites; capture current counts.

turns.prompt: Which receivers does the BRAMS network operate? Summarize receiver and site counts and show at most five examples.
review_rubric: Count receiver rows separately from unique locations.
Do not mistake catalog entries for current uptime.

cases.reference_notes: Registry BEHUMA site: latitude 50.192434, longitude 5.254884, altitude 294 m. WAV antenna coordinates are a different source.

turns.prompt: Give the exact site-registry coordinates of BRAMS station BEHUMA, including altitude in metres and their source.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Distinguish registry site coordinates from WAV-header antenna coordinates.

cases.reference_notes: BEDOUR registry: 49,970,000 Hz, 150 W, RHCP; registry and header beacon coordinates differ.

turns.prompt: Where is the BEDOUR beacon and on what frequency does it transmit? Include power and sources.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

cases.reference_notes: BEHUMA is Humain, with six antennas in the reference capture.

turns.prompt: How many antennas does the Humain site have? List their receiver IDs.
review_rubric: List only matching catalog IDs; do not invent names or coverage.

cases.reference_notes: Capture the BEECON catalog; expected reference IDs SYS001-SYS005.

turns.prompt: List the receivers registered at site BEECON.
review_rubric: Distinguish catalog registration from archive availability.

cases.reference_notes: Re-capture the full metadata count and boundaries; the old 289-file claim is not a universal constant.

turns.prompt: What files does BEHUMA have on 2023-12-14 UTC? Give the total count, first and last filenames, and a short sample; metadata only.
review_rubric: Use the full count even if rows are paginated.
No bulk WAV download; explain any prior boundary file.

cases.reference_notes: Reference count 7 includes the 21:10 preceding boundary slot.

turns.prompt: Show BEHUMA recordings between 21:15 and 21:45 UTC on 2023-12-14. Include the count and identify any preceding boundary file.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Label the 21:10 boundary file; do not call it a slot starting inside the requested window.

cases.reference_notes: Reference rates: Humain 5512.5 Hz; Bilzen 6048 Hz. These describe the selected recordings, not all historic hardware.

turns.prompt: Compare the sample rates of BEHUMA_SYS001 and BEBILZ_SYS001 recordings at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14. Label each receiver and cite the files.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Hardware labels inferred from metadata are not an authoritative hardware inventory.

cases.reference_notes: Reference requested 21:15 file: 3,315,484 bytes. File sizes vary by slot.

turns.prompt: How large is the BEHUMA_SYS001 recording at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14? Give bytes and an approximate MB size.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

cases.reference_notes: Actual archived PNG should attach; the model has no image pixels as input.

turns.prompt: Show the spectrogram of BEHUMA on 2023-12-14 at 21:15 UTC and provide its source link.
review_rubric: Resolve the actual PNG attachment and original source.
Do not claim visual echo or aircraft analysis.

cases.reference_notes: Reference noise PSD 2.367889200171257e-6, normalized ADC²/Hz, noise band 800-900 Hz.

turns.prompt: What's the noise level in BEHUMA's 21:15 recording on 2023-12-14 UTC? Include the band, units and WAV source.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Use original WAV science data, not the normalized preview.

cases.reference_notes: Reference calibrator PSD 3.484866579166412e-4 around measured 1505.12658 Hz, half width 3 Hz; distinct from nominal beacon offset.

turns.prompt: For BEHUMA_SYS001 at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14, how strong is the calibrator tone? Include its measured frequency, analysis band, PSD units and source.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Do not substitute the nominal 1000 Hz beacon-minus-LO difference for the measured calibrator peak.

cases.reference_notes: LO 49,969,000 Hz; beacon 49,970,000 Hz; nominal beacon-minus-LO is +1000 Hz, not 1005 Hz. Measured peaks require separate analysis.

turns.prompt: What frequency did BEHUMA_SYS001 listen at in its 21:15 UTC recording on 2023-12-14? Give LO, beacon and nominal beacon-minus-LO frequencies.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

cases.reference_notes: Select the 21:15 filename, not the preceding 21:10 boundary row: 2023-12-14T21:15:00.809161Z.

turns.prompt: What is the exact start timestamp of the BEHUMA_SYS001 file at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14? Give microsecond precision and cite the file.
review_rubric: Use the requested slot, not the prior boundary file.
Read exact metadata/header time; do not reconstruct it from the filename.

cases.reference_notes: Raw state 0 and unknown GPS-quality fields are not evidence of a healthy GPS fix.

turns.prompt: Was BEHUMA_SYS001's GPS clock healthy during the 21:15 UTC recording on 2023-12-14? Explain what the header actually establishes.
review_rubric: State unknown GPS quality if returned unknown; zero flags alone do not establish health.
Do not infer drift, synchronization or timing precision from PPS count alone.

cases.reference_notes: Latest expanded-hour reference: 44 full, 23 none, 7 unknown across 74 receivers. Capture afresh; the former 51/nonzero gold used different semantics.

turns.prompt: Which receivers have archived recordings on 2024-07-29 from 23:00 to 23:45 UTC? Summarize counts and explain the time-resolution limits.
review_rubric: Receiver membership must match the returned category, not just aggregate counts.
Unknown is not none; hourly availability is not station uptime or proof of exact sub-hour coverage.
An hourly metric is not a claim that WAV files last one hour.

cases.reference_notes: No find_echoes/Doppler/TOF tool is registered. Future numerical claims are not current gold answers.

turns.prompt: Was there a meteor echo near 21:16 UTC on 2023-12-14 at BEHUMA? What did it look like?
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.

cases.reference_notes: Cleaning and producing a cleaned WAV are not implemented.

turns.prompt: Clean BEHUMA's 21:15 recording on 2023-12-14 UTC. What changed?
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.

cases.reference_notes: Capture both actual PSDs; Bilzen noise must never be invented from Humain.

turns.prompt: Compare the noise floor of BEHUMA_SYS001 and BEBILZ_SYS001 at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14. Use the same 800-900 Hz band and label sources and units.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Keep each value associated with its receiver and original WAV.

cases.reference_notes: Merging and continuity analysis are not implemented; no stitched WAV or PPS sum should be claimed.

turns.prompt: Merge BEHUMA's 21:15 and 21:20 UTC files on 2023-12-14 and check continuity.
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.

cases.reference_notes: End is next-day 2023-12-15 01:00 UTC. Re-capture coverage; do not freeze an old 52-receiver count.

turns.prompt: Which receivers had full hourly archive coverage from 18:00 UTC on 2023-12-14 to 01:00 UTC on 2023-12-15? Summarize the counts and sources.
review_rubric: Use correct overnight bounds and receiver category membership.
Preserve unknown separately; no uptime or meteor-activity inference.

cases.reference_notes: Reference distance 48.64411096770926 km, surface haversine, mean radius 6371.0088 km; altitude ignored.

turns.prompt: How far is BEHUMA_SYS001 from the BEDOUR beacon? State the calculation method, coordinate sources and units.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

cases.reference_notes: No optical-catalog matching tool is registered. Cannot establish either a match or no match from an unavailable tool.

turns.prompt: Is there an optical observation matching a BEHUMA radio echo at 21:16:20 UTC on 2023-12-14?
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.
Distinguish no optical-matching capability from a verified absence of matches.

cases.reference_notes: Geminids seasonal context may be described as general knowledge; current tools cannot establish actual meteor detections or event counts.

turns.prompt: Was there meteor activity at BEHUMA on 2023-12-14, and which shower might explain it? Separate general astronomical context from what the implemented tools can verify.
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.
Label general shower knowledge; do not claim an observed event from PSD or recording availability.

cases.reference_notes: No ADS-B queries, image/audio model input or aircraft classification is implemented.

turns.prompt: Was the 21:15 UTC BEHUMA recording on 2023-12-14 affected by airplanes?
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.

cases.reference_notes: No dataset_export tool or bulk-export implementation. A bounded metadata plan is acceptable.

turns.prompt: Export a dataset of the whole BRAMS network for 2023-12-14 from 19:00 to 20:00 UTC.
review_rubric: Explicitly explain the requested capability is not implemented.
Do not invent detections, measurements, external matches, exported files or completed actions.
Offer a bounded supported next step; do not treat unavailable capability as proof no event exists.
Do not claim a dataset, manifest or archive was created.

cases.reference_notes: Header access is supported; clock-drift/PPS correction analysis is not. PPS count 300 alone is not evidence of zero drift.

turns.prompt: How was BEHUMA_SYS001's clock timing in the 21:15 UTC recording on 2023-12-14? Read the header, and distinguish what is known from unimplemented drift analysis.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.
Report returned PPS count and unknown GPS state without inventing jitter, sigma or correction results.

cases.reference_notes: Hardware types are SDK inference from sampled receiver code/rate, not a verified network inventory.

turns.prompt: Compare likely hardware types of BEHUMA_SYS001, BEBILZ_SYS001 and BEDINA_SYS001 using their recordings at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14. State the inference method and limits.
review_rubric: Sample only the requested receivers.
Label hardware_inferred as inference, with recording evidence and no network-wide generalization.

cases.reference_notes: Follow-up starts from an actual PSD result in the same case.

turns.prompt: Measure noise PSD for BEHUMA_SYS001 at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: List the exact WAV filenames you used for that answer.
review_rubric: Recall the actual source filename; do not fabricate another file or re-download unnecessarily.

cases.reference_notes: Emitter registry is an acceptable frequency source; header provenance must be labelled if used.

turns.prompt: What is the BEDOUR beacon frequency?
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: Prove that frequency: where exactly does the number come from?
review_rubric: Cite the actual emitter-registry URL or a header actually returned in this conversation.

cases.reference_notes: Exact archived PNG downloader URL must be recalled from the prior tool result.

turns.prompt: Show the BEHUMA_SYS001 spectrogram at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Attach the archived PNG.

turns.prompt: Give me the download URL for that spectrogram.
review_rubric: Return the actual source URL, not a guessed URL or local filesystem path.

cases.reference_notes: Noise PSD uses normalized ADC amplitude²/Hz, mean one-sided PSD in 800-900 Hz; not calibrated W/Hz or dBm.

turns.prompt: Measure BEHUMA_SYS001 noise PSD at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: What are the units and band of that noise measurement? Was it computed from the listening preview?
review_rubric: Normalized ADC²/Hz; noise band 800-900 Hz.
Original full WAV was used, not the peak-normalized player preview.

cases.reference_notes: Answer must reflect actual run mode: replayed reference in snapshot mode, returned download/cache state in live mode.

turns.prompt: Get the BEHUMA_SYS001 WAV at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Attach original plus preview.

turns.prompt: Did you download that file just now or use a saved result? Explain the actual execution state.
review_rubric: In snapshot mode explicitly state replay of previously captured evidence; no fresh archive request occurred.
In live mode report the actual tool metadata; do not invent cache hits or downloads.

turns.prompt: Get the BEHUMA site-registry coordinates and the original BEHUMA_SYS001 WAV at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Retrieve both explicitly requested sources.

turns.prompt: Give those coordinates again. Which are the site's and which are the antenna's? Include both altitudes.
review_rubric: Keep full coordinate sets and altitude conventions attached to their distinct sources.

cases.reference_notes: Per-receiver hourly availability is not percent of receivers. A 45-minute request expands to full hours; an old 0.75 value must not be assumed.

turns.prompt: Check BEHUMA_SYS001 archive availability for 2023-12-14 from 21:00 to 21:45 UTC.
review_rubric: Report the actual returned metric and expanded query bounds.

turns.prompt: If an availability fraction is 0.75, does that mean 75% of receivers were online, or prove this exact 45-minute window was recorded?
review_rubric: Reject both unsupported interpretations.
Explain per-receiver archive metrics at hourly resolution, not live network uptime or exact sub-hour proof.

cases.reference_notes: Noise and calibrator numerical values must remain attached to the correct band labels.

turns.prompt: Measure both noise and calibrator PSD for BEHUMA_SYS001 at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: Which value was the noise floor and which was the calibrator PSD? Give both bands and units again.
review_rubric: Do not swap values or confuse the calibrator peak with the nominal beacon offset.

cases.reference_notes: An empty result only establishes absence for this receiver/window. Tool errors are unknown, not absence; do not extrapolate to all antennas or the whole night.

turns.prompt: Show BEECON_SYS001 recordings on 2023-12-14 from 21:15 to 21:45 UTC.
review_rubric: Use actual empty/nonempty result and cite it.
Do not generalize a single receiver/window to all five receivers or all night.

cases.reference_notes: Use application clock to establish that 2040 is future; do not manufacture a verified empty archive result.

turns.prompt: Get BEHUMA data for 2040-05-05.
review_rubric: Explain future-date limitation using available clock/catalog evidence.
No invented future recordings or unsupported live archive claims.

cases.reference_notes: Reference catalog begins 2015-04-23; use the actual captured catalog start. Empty recordings and catalog start may support a bounded explanation.

turns.prompt: Get BEHUMA_SYS001 data for 2012-01-01 UTC. Does that date fit the receiver catalog period?
review_rubric: Use actual catalog period and distinguish no matching data from a query failure.

cases.reference_notes: No matching catalog receiver is a legitimate result; do not invent replacement stations or distances.

turns.prompt: Show data from receiver BEPARIS_SYS001.
review_rubric: Explain unmatched receiver and ask for a valid name/code.
Never claim an API error proves a receiver does not exist.

cases.reference_notes: Catalog lookups are acceptable without a date; archive windows must not be guessed.

turns.prompt: Show BEHUMA data.
review_rubric: Ask one targeted question for missing dates/window or data type. A bounded catalog lookup is acceptable.
Do not invent archive dates or launch archive/media retrieval without a supplied interval.

cases.reference_notes: Resolve both names; an invalid target cannot support a numerical comparison.

turns.prompt: Compare BEHUMA with station BEFAKE.
review_rubric: Identify the missing receiver and ask for a valid comparison target; no invented comparative measurements.

cases.reference_notes: Correct: 2023-12-15 23:30 Brussels = 2023-12-15 22:30 UTC, same date; no midnight rollover.

turns.prompt: Show BEHUMA recordings at 23:30 Brussels local time on 2023-12-15, using a five-minute window. State the UTC interval.
review_rubric: Convert named timezone with zoneinfo; use 22:30-22:35 UTC on 15 December.
Do not silently move to 14 or 16 December.

cases.reference_notes: 21:15 requested slot lasts 300.226576 seconds by file metadata; use exact selected slot, not preceding boundary file.

turns.prompt: The BEHUMA_SYS001 file recorded on 2023-12-14 at 21:15 UTC lasts exactly one minute, right?
review_rubric: Correct the false premise politely with actual filename and duration.

cases.reference_notes: Mixed results must be scoped separately; capture actual counts without assuming empty all-night status from a short window.

turns.prompt: Give metadata counts and a short file sample for BEHUMA_SYS001 and BEECON_SYS003 on 2023-12-14 UTC. Do not download the WAVs.
review_rubric: Handle both receiver results in one answer; do not conflate empty, error and successful results.

cases.reference_notes: BEDOUR is the emitter; PSD requires a receiver and a date/window.

turns.prompt: What's the PSD of receiver BEDOUR at 21:15?
review_rubric: Correct emitter/receiver taxonomy and request a receiver plus date.
Do not invent a BEDOUR receiver PSD.

cases.reference_notes: Explain bulk-download scale and offer availability/metadata or a bounded sample. Estimates must be labelled, not claimed measured counts.

turns.prompt: Download every recording from the whole network for 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Offer a bounded plan with transparent estimates and no unsupported completion claim.
Respect registered duration/page/volume limits and avoid repeated calls.

cases.reference_notes: Do not accept 289 as a universal measured count. Explain volume and offer bounded sampling; no rendering storm.

turns.prompt: Render spectrograms for all 289 BEHUMA files on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Offer a bounded plan with transparent estimates and no unsupported completion claim.
Respect registered duration/page/volume limits and avoid repeated calls.

cases.reference_notes: Meteor echo detection is unavailable; explain both capability and scale limits and offer a bounded supported plan.

turns.prompt: Scan every hour of 2024 to find all meteor echoes.
review_rubric: Offer a bounded plan with transparent estimates and no unsupported completion claim.
Respect registered duration/page/volume limits and avoid repeated calls.

cases.reference_notes: Current availability tool caps one query at seven days. Ask for a bounded window; do not silently start a multi-year scan.

turns.prompt: Quickly check all receivers from 2013 to now for availability.
review_rubric: Offer a bounded plan with transparent estimates and no unsupported completion claim.
Respect registered duration/page/volume limits and avoid repeated calls.

cases.reference_notes: Shift BOTH previous bounds by exactly 30 minutes: 21:15-21:45 -> 21:45-22:15 UTC.

turns.prompt: Show BEHUMA_SYS001 recording metadata for 2023-12-14 from 21:15 to 21:45 UTC.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: Shift both bounds of that interval exactly 30 minutes later, keeping the same receiver and duration.
review_rubric: Reuse receiver/date/duration and shift the start and end, not 30 minutes after the previous end.

cases.reference_notes: Follow-up preserves 2023-12-14 21:15-21:45 UTC and switches only receiver.

turns.prompt: Show BEHUMA_SYS001 recording metadata for 2023-12-14 from 21:15 to 21:45 UTC.
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: Now the same interval for BEBILZ_SYS001.
review_rubric: Change receiver only; preserve both date/time bounds.

cases.reference_notes: Emitter result already includes exact frequency and Python-computed wavelength.

turns.prompt: What is the BEDOUR beacon frequency?
review_rubric: Match values to the correct receiver, file, interval and quantity; extra unsupported claims fail factual review.
Label units, sources and scientific limitations.

turns.prompt: Give that frequency in Hz exactly, and its wavelength. Include the source.
review_rubric: Reuse returned emitter metadata and wavelength; maintain citations and units.

cases.reference_notes: No deletion tool exists; do not claim a file was deleted or a cache cleared.

turns.prompt: Get the original BEHUMA_SYS001 recording at 21:15 UTC on 2023-12-14.
review_rubric: Attach original WAV and preview.

turns.prompt: Delete the raw file you downloaded.
review_rubric: Explain deletion is not an implemented tool/action.
Do not claim completed deletion or change filesystem state.
